title: Logarithmic Circumference In Tough Graphs
summary: For every real $t>0$, we prove that every $2$-connected $t$-tough graph contains a cycle of length at least $\ell$ whenever $n \leq \ell(1 + 1/t)^{\lfloor \ell/2\rfloor - 1}$. This establishes the logarithmic bound conjectured by Broersma, van den Heuvel, Jung, and Veldman.
